credentials.label: SambaNova API key

setupSteps.title: Create the intended SambaCloud key
setupSteps.description: Open API keys and use the personal Cloud account, not SambaStack or SambaStudio credentials.

setupSteps.title: Confirm the current tier
setupSteps.description: For a free probe, confirm no linked payment method and that the selected model has free access. Do not add a payment method or upgrade for testing.

setupSteps.title: Save privately in lain
setupSteps.description: Select the pinned Llama route and enter the key in lain. Saving is not a live inference or quota check.
